An anchor wrapping a table renders the table as a block instead of an escaped link label

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<a href=\"https://example.com/outer\"><table><tr><td><a href=\"https://example.com/inner\">Inner</a></td></tr></table></a>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
